intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} are both public Delhi University colleges offering {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded year fees, the placements we can use, and India Today ranks from our table, with official sites opened in {{year}}.
Daulat Ram College vs Hindu College is not a close ranking fight. Hindu College holds India Today ranks of 1 in 2024 and 2023 on our records. Daulat Ram College is listed at 16 in 2024.

sections.heading: Daulat Ram College vs Hindu College for BA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Hindu College if you want a public DU honours BA with a recorded Total Fees year figure of ₹25,300, a 2023 English row of ₹10 lakh average and ₹37 lakh highest, and India Today ranks of 1 in 2024 and 2023.

Choose Daulat Ram College if that campus and subject fit you, with recorded year tuition of ₹14,870 on one BA set and ₹15,890 on another, after official confirmation, knowing the only placement row we hold is from 2016.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Daulat Ram College we hold year tuition of ₹14,870 on older-named BA rows such as English, economics, psychology, Hindi and Sanskrit, and ₹15,890 on later-named rows including philosophy, history and political science.

For Hindu College we hold ₹25,300 as a Total Fees year figure for several BA (Hons) subjects. A separate B.A tuition row of ₹2,230 is also stored; do not quote that small head as the honours programme fee.

These are year figures, not confirmed official three-year totals. Confirm the current DU college notices on the official Daulat Ram and Hindu College sites, including any society or practical charges.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Hindu College has a 2023 BA (Hons) English row of ₹10 lakh average and ₹37 lakh highest. A 2010 row is also stored; do not treat 2010 as a current figure.
Daulat Ram College has only a 2016 BA English row, with a highest of ₹6 lakh and no usable average. That year is too old to use as a 2026 comparison.
Ask both placement cells for a later official arts report. Many BA graduates also look at further study, so packages should not be the only test.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Hindu College is listed with CUET UG. Daulat Ram College has no exam mapped on this page, though both are public DU colleges. Follow the official CUET UG and DU admissions process, and do not rely on an outdated college-level exam note.
On our records, Hindu College has India Today ranks of 1 in 2024 and 2023. Daulat Ram College has India Today ranks of 16 in 2024 and 15 in 2023 and 2021. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Delhi, as public colleges, so a local student can visit them on the same day.

The subject lists overlap in English, economics, Hindi, history and political science, but they are not identical. Hindu College also lists sociology and music. Match the honours subject, not only the brand.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Hindu College if the India Today rank of 1, the 2023 English placement row and that North Campus offer are the goal, after you confirm the official year fee.
Pick Daulat Ram College if that campus and subject are the seat you have, after official fee confirmation, without using the 2016 placement row as a current figure.
Do not quote Hindu College's ₹2,230 tuition head as the honours fee.
